# ESOFT Lifelong Learning

> > ESOFT Lifelong Learning delivers comprehensive online professional development and soft skills training across project management, financial services, compliance, and artificial intelligence.

ESOFT Lifelong Learning is an Ireland-based provider of lifelong learning and professional development courses, operating under The Growth Catalysts Team. The platform specializes in soft skills training, business acumen, and compliance education tailored for professionals across Europe.

## Key Topics

- Professional Development
- Lifelong Learning
- Online Courses
- Project Management
- Financial Services
- Artificial Intelligence
- Compliance Training
- Business Skills
- Workplace Training
- Leadership & Management
- Anti-Money Laundering (AML)
- Human Resources
- LEAN & Six Sigma
- Ireland-based Training
- EU Professional Development

## Course Offerings

- [Courses Online Ireland](https://esoftskills.ie/courses): Main course catalog featuring online training in project management and financial services
- [Online Courses Catalogue](https://esoftskills.ie/online-courses-catalogue): Comprehensive online courses catalogue covering business skills, AI, and professional development
